title: The Treasure — Sc117: Anais makes her case (Darwin in the fishbowl)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: Dialogue staging with an unequal movement budget: over 136 frames in the photographic bedroom, only Anais actually performs -- she starts centre-frame smiling, cracks up laughing (~frame 35), turns furious and stomps her way to frame-right (frames 52-69), softens into pleading (~frame 85) and ends smiling again. Her brothers are near-frozen gags: Gumball sits on the lower bunk wearing one worried look for the whole scene, and Darwin stands inside a fishbowl on the dresser -- body behind the BOWL_FRONT glass layer, head out of the top -- moving only his eyes until the last frame, when his mouth finally opens. The construction lesson is the sandwich: character layer(s) + a front-glass prop layer = a character credibly inside a transparent container, no special rig required.
notes: Darwin is built from two layers -- 'DARWIN' and 'DARWIN copy' holding v001/v002 of the GB211_DARWIN_IN_BOWL_SHOT125 puppet -- with a 'BOWL_FRONT' layer (prop GB202Remote_Props_FishBowl_v002.fxg) sandwiched over him: body behind glass, head and arms out of the top.
The same photographic bedroom as Sc122's plate, but rendered paler/washed here; the file carries a 'transparency' DOMGroup layer between the characters and the background plate.

Movement budget is radically unequal: Anais crosses from centre to frame-right and runs the full emotion arc, while Gumball changes almost nothing and Darwin only shifts his eyes until his mouth finally opens at frame 136.
The in-bowl Darwin puppet is named for Shot 125 yet carries scenes 117 and 122 as well -- one gag build, at least three scenes of use.
